deficiencies.description: The text merely places the statement about explanting tumours and the observation of a slice through a tumour next to each other. The rewrite adds the link that the slice 'illustrates this', presenting the slice as an illustration of tumour explantation.

deficiencies.description: In the source text, 'So' links the surprise to the preceding fact that primary cells do not grow in culture ('Primary cells really don't grow in culture. So when HeLa cells... did that, this was very much a surprise'). In the rewrite, 'and so' connects the surprise directly to HeLa cells being the first tumour cells to grow in culture, changing the stated cause of the surprise.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: Primary cells really don't grow in culture. So when HeLa cells, which were the first tumor cells to grow in culture, did that, this was very much a surprise.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: Primary cells do not grow in culture. HeLa cells were the first tumour cells to grow in culture, and so this was very much a surprise.
